title: LIF membrane timescale × threshold factorization
amendment: 02: include pre-reset peak membrane in stability audit and assert all serialized tensor roundtrips; fresh seeds replaced
scope: Synthetic CPU recurrent LIF parameter reconstruction; SVD is an oracle compression diagnostic, not trained Mirror or capacity evidence.
hypothesis: Task×neuron membrane tau and threshold tables can be compressed by shared neuron bases plus small task coordinates when the teacher tables are factorized; generic tables expose when private/full state is needed.
physical_object: One fixed recurrent 8-neuron LIF synapse core with an 8-input event encoder shared across tasks.
mirror_coordinate: For each parameter table M[q,n] in {tau,theta}, store rank-r factors A[q,:], B[:,n] and reconstruct M≈AB.
controls: independent full task×neuron tau/threshold upper control
ordinary native SVD factorization with identical math and factors

teacher_families.structured_rank1: tau[q,n]=task_tau[q]*neuron_tau[n] and theta[q,n]=task_theta[q]*neuron_theta[n] with positive bounded factors.
teacher_families.generic_random: Independent uniform tau and threshold values per task/neuron, within fixed bounds.

data: Fresh Bernoulli event streams for each task, class, and seed; every condition sees identical streams and the fixed encoder/recurrent weights.

development.selection_metric: runtime/shape smoke only; no rank selection from fresh results

training.method: oracle truncated SVD of the predefined teacher parameter bank

storage.authority: actual custom serialized inference payload bytes
storage.format: same typed-tensor stream plus JSON manifest for every control
paid_objects: tau and threshold full tables or factors

success_gate: On structured_rank1 fresh worlds, rank-1 achieves >=95% teacher spike Hamming agreement, full payload <=80% of independent, and finite stable voltages; compare ordinary rank-1 exact alias. Report generic-random separately.
failure_gate: Quality, actual-byte, or stability gate miss. Any exact native low-rank alias precludes Mirror-specific attribution.
boundaries: No learned SNN, STL-SNN/TACOS reproduction, natural event data, hardware energy, or capacity claim.
SVD uses the teacher parameter bank and is an oracle compression upper bound.
Task IDs are provided to all task-conditioned variants and task mapping is charged.
Factorized states reconstruct dense tau/threshold tables at load; report the full runtime table memory and decode work.
verification_amendments: Amendment 01 computed max_abs_membrane after subtractive reset, underreporting the true pre-reset peak; its metrics are preserved and excluded as decision-quality stability evidence.
Amendment 02 records peak before reset, checks every payload tensor roundtrip, and uses new seeds 96421, 96423, 96427.
